params.body:
## What

The blog becomes **Stories** in the Studio.

- **Menu:** "Blog" is now "Stories". It has a **Pagina Stories** item that opens the settings of the overview: intro, featured story, film for desktop and mobile with their posters. Under it are Artikels and Tags. "Stories tonen" switches it on the site.
- **FAQ block** (`faqBlock`) in an article: an optional title and questions with a short answer. Answers can carry links.
- **Links:**
  - a new `siteLink` mark that links to the Contact page or the whole FAQ page;
  - an internal link can now also point at one FAQ question.

  Hoet can lay these links themselves.
- **No categories.** Stories starts without folders, so the following are removed: the `journalCategory` type, the category field on a story, its seed script, the slug check against category addresses, and the menu item. No story referred to a category, and the five category documents are already deleted from the dataset.
- **Preview button:** now opens `/stories/preview/{id}`.

## Checked

- 95 tests pass (`vitest`, without the token-bound `config.test.ts`). `tsc`, `sanity schema validate` (0 errors, 0 warnings) and lint pass.
- The member list of the article body and the link targets are shared fixtures with hoet-eyewear (`tests/fixtures/article-body-members.json`, `tests/fixtures/site-link-targets.json`). A block or link target added on one side fails the other's test until it is handled there.

## After merge

`npm run deploy` for the Studio, after the hoet-eyewear PR is merged.
params.title: Stories in the Studio: page settings, FAQ block, Contact and FAQ links, no categories
